title: 2140 Prairie's Tucker/Smith mansion: banded red brick and three towers
items: The corner mansion at Prairie Avenue and 22nd Street now stands on the house kit: red brick banded in pale stone over a stone basement, a slated mansard with dormers and iron cresting, a round tower across the corner, a polygonal tower on 22nd Street and a square tower on Prairie, each under a crested slate cap, read off the 1911 map and two photographs.
